Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
VTES card text: "Only usable if at least one card is contested.
For each contested card, choose the Methuselah you want to yield.
Successful [referendum] means that all the chosen Methuselahs
yield <as you selected>."

Jyhad card text: "Choose who among those with contested cards
in play should get each card. Successful [referendum] means all
other Methuselahs must immediately burn the contested cards."

The way the most recent printing is worded, it sounds like you'd
only be able to force one person to yield for each card being
contested - ie if there were three or more people contesting a
single card, you could make one of them yield, but not all but one.
The Jyhad version, on the other hand, has you choose the one
Methuselah who doesn't yield, rather than the one who does. Which
way should it be played?

Thanks,

Josh

hypothetical-question-asking prince of washington dc

Messages.Author: Gene Wirchenko
Messages.Body:
LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:

>Joshua Duffin wrote:
>>
>> VTES card text: "Only usable if at least one card is contested.
>> For each contested card, choose the Methuselah you want to yield.
>> Successful [referendum] means that all the chosen Methuselahs
>> yield <as you selected>."

Yielding happens during the untap phase. The card text does not
specify a change to this. So...

Play order: A-B-C

B and C are contesting a card. Player A selects player C to
yield. The card is still contested for the remainder of player A's
turn and for player B's turn. On player C's turn, he yields as
required.

Is player B required to pay because the card is still contested
on his turn? If player C doesn't pay (i.e. he yields), is player C
still required to yield? CAN player C yield (since the card is no
longer contested)?

[snip]

>> The Jyhad version, on the other hand, has you choose the one
>> Methuselah who doesn't yield, rather than the one who does. Which
>> way should it be played?
>
>Most Recent Printing.

Sincerely,

Gene Wirchenko

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Gene Wirchenko wrote:
>
> LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote:
>
> >Joshua Duffin wrote:
> >>
> >> VTES card text: "Only usable if at least one card is contested.
> >> For each contested card, choose the Methuselah you want to yield.
> >> Successful [referendum] means that all the chosen Methuselahs
> >> yield <as you selected>."
>
> Yielding happens during the untap phase. The card text does not
> specify a change to this. So...

Yes it does: "the chosen Methuselahs yield". Immediate command mode.
Not "the chosen Methuselahs must yield on their next untap phases."

> Play order: A-B-C
>
> B and C are contesting a card. Player A selects player C to
> yield. The card is still contested for the remainder of player A's
> turn and for player B's turn. On player C's turn, he yields as
> required.

No. C yields when the referendum passes. B regains control on his untap.
